selected_evidence.summary: The directories exist, the exact fstab entry validates cleanly, /mnt/inventory is mounted from /srv/inventory, and both paths have the same filesystem identity.
Captured a healthy baseline, received safe-reboot acknowledgement, observed a changed boot ID, and proved the system, mount unit, bind mount, and pre-reboot data recovered.

id; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
